content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the vilnius city district court the court made a final decision regarding the division of matrimonial property the movable property including a car was awarded to the applicant while the immovable property consisting of a house buildings land and a car trailer was awarded to the defendant however the defendant was ordered to pay compensation to the applicant the text also discusses joint matrimonial property the determination of asset value and shareable property the applicant filed a lawsuit seeking the dissolution of their marriage division of property maintenance payments and a contact regime for the defendant with their children the court will decide on the division of property and maintenance payments based on the parties financial situation and the best interests of the children the court also supports a counterclaim made by one of the parties the defendant is responsible for repaying borrowed funds and is solely liable for a creditor the applicant is awarded a personal car and the right to use the dwelling house until their daughter reaches adulthood the defendant is ordered to pay compensation and stamp duty
